prompts.city_painted:
Use case: illustration-story / style-transfer. Production transparent game-prop atlas for the EXISTING Trætoppen treetop city. Image 1 (buildings.png) and Image 2 (nature.png) are the EXACT visual style references: match their detailed hand-painted storybook gouache/watercolor, gently uneven warm grey-brown pencil contours, worn timber grain, layered organic roof materials, delicate moss and tiny plants, warm amber windows, restrained earthy palette, subtle paper tooth. Image 3 (hut_m_moss.webp) is ONLY the simple round hut shape and camera/perspective reference: replace its smooth model-rendered look completely with the painted reference style. Do not copy the reference sheet compositions.
Create ONE transparent 2048x2048 atlas, strict 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid of TWELVE distinct isolated props, each centered within its invisible equal cell with wide transparent gutters, no overlap. Entire object visible. Camera fixed elevated 36 degrees, orthographic, looking at the front and right; upright walls, round bases project to ellipses of height about .58 of width. Single-storey round huts appropriate to elevated wooden tree platforms, not tall ground cottages. No ground, foundation slab, shadows, paper, labels, writing, visible grid, characters, or thick black outlines. True transparent background, no white border.
Exact row-major order:
1. A small ROUND timber treetop hut, low cylindrical walls of weathered honey timber, broad layered golden straw conical roof with a softly bent organic tip, small round amber windows and a front round-topped wood door; tiny moss, no balcony.
2. The same round low treetop hut with a sage-green overlapping leaf/moss conical roof, cream plaster between timber ribs, small amber windows, round-topped front door, small hanging herbs.
3. The same round low treetop hut with a muted lavender-dark bark-shingle conical roof, dark worn timber walls, round amber windows and a round-topped front door.
4. A slightly grander ROUND fairy town hall hut, two gently layered lavender roof tiers, rustic cream plaster and timber, brass leaf finial, round warm windows, small front door, a little ivy. Still broad and low, no tower or ground base.
5. A hanging bat-house, dark muted lavender wooden enclosed hut with a small round entry near its broad TOP and an inverted tapered pointed BOTTOM, hangs under a deck, no ropes or bats; hand-painted carved wood, tiny brass hinges.
6. An owl's small hollow knot-hole doorway in rough gnarled tree bark, dark oval hollow with a tiny inset wooden frame and short shelf at bottom, moss flecks. No owl, no eyes.
7. A rustic open market stall, sage green cloth canopy, weathered timber supports and counter, few folded cream sacks, no lettering.
8. A small rustic wooden notice board with two rough supporting posts and pitched mossy little roof, blank pinned cream papers, no writing, full posts visible.
9. A low rectangular wooden planter box holding soft green herbs, a few tiny purple flowers and uneven soil, organic hand-painted wood.
10. A small tidy stack of three weathered cut wood logs with visible annual rings and rough mossy bark, no axe.
11. A low rounded woven wicker basket holding a few cream cloth seed sacks and a couple green seedlings, no labels.
12. A broad low oval copper-and-wood bathing tub, open top with pale turquoise water, curved wood staves, small rounded copper rim, no occupant, no legs or plumbing sticking outside silhouette.
Keep each object coherent as one extractable alpha island. Fine detail but clear readable silhouettes at small game scale. No glossy 3D render, plastic cylinders, faceted polygons, vector icons, photorealism, or baked lighting gradients.
prompts.forest_painted:
Use case: illustration-story / style-transfer. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for the EXISTING Mørkeskoven dark forest in a cozy Godot game. Image 1 nature.png and Image 2 terrain.png are exact style references: detailed storybook hand-painted gouache/watercolor, fine uneven warm grey pencil contours, organic leaves and worn natural materials, muted earthy moss/olive/sage pigments with cool teal and slate-lavender shadows, subtle paper tooth. Image 3 crown_m_a.png is an OLD SHAPE/CAMERA REFERENCE ONLY; replace its spherical 3D blobs with a leafy illustrated canopy. Image 4 cave_ring.png is an OLD FOOTPRINT REFERENCE ONLY: keep the broad ellipse and central dark opening, replace the smooth pale ring with rough painted stones. These props are illuminated in-game by a dark blue nighttime tint and lights, so paint readable neutral albedo, not near-black artwork and no baked bloom or huge halos.
Create ONE 2048x2048 transparent atlas, strict 3 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid, NINE distinct separate objects. Whole silhouettes within equal invisible cells, generous transparent margins, no overlap, no ground or cast shadows, paper, background, labels, letters, numerals, visible grid, characters, eyes or faces. Fine illustrated detail that remains legible at small game scale. All camera views elevated 36 degrees orthographic; canopy objects are viewed mainly from above and have broad rounded irregular crowns of height about .65-.8 of width with small optional visible lower twigs, NOT full-height tree trunks. No smooth spheres, cylinders, glossy renders, faceted low-poly leaves, vectors, pixel art or photographs.
Exact row-major order:
1. A large broad ancient oak CANOPY seen from above, rounded organic silhouette of many hand-painted overlapping olive/sage leaves in irregular sprays, hints of twisting dark branches between leaves and soft teal shaded recesses, a few dried copper leaves. No full tree trunk, shadow or ground.
2. A different broad woodland CANOPY seen from above, cooler muted blue-green foliage, asymmetrical lobed crown of countless delicately painted leaves, slate-lavender shaded inner twigs, organic ragged outline. No full tree trunk, shadow or ground.
3. A low broad conifer CANOPY seen from above, overlapping soft evergreen needle sprays forming an irregular oval, moss-green lit tips, desaturated teal/slate shaded interior, intricate painterly texture. No full tree trunk, shadow or ground.
4. A broad low ellipse of rough weathered violet-grey stones surrounding a large completely DARK oval hole, a downward cave opening in the forest floor, not an upright arch. Ellipse .58 as tall as wide, irregular angular boulders, subtle moss and worn edges, no glowing eyes and no surrounding ground.
5. A solitary standing rough slate-grey runestone, full irregular stone silhouette, a single simple angular turquoise rune carved in its front, slight moss at base, no cast shadow, glowing halo or platform. The rune is a simple angular lightning-like glyph, no writing.
6. A small cluster of three softly painted turquoise/teal mushrooms with cream undersides, irregular curved stems, delicate gills and pale little cap flecks, slight moss at their base; no bloom or halo, dark-forest albedo.
7. A low dense bush of small muted deep sage/teal leaves with scattered dried copper leaves and tiny twig tips, intricate hand-painted silhouette, no eyes, no berries, no shadow.
8. A small cluster of five irregular slate-grey and taupe forest stones with thin moss seams and a fern frond, painterly rough surfaces, no ground patch or shadow.
9. A little cluster of three pond lily leaves seen from above in a shallow .58 ellipse projection, organic dark sage-green pads with notches and fine hand-painted veins, one tiny pale cream closed bud; no water background or shadow.
